sq.QUESTION_DESC: Why is it important to understand the co-existence of humans and nature?

lq.ANSWER: Harmony in the Self means that the activities of the Self are aligned with natural acceptance and right understanding. The Self has activities such as desire, thought and expectation. If these are guided by preconditioning or sensation, then the Self becomes confused and unhappy. For example, a person may desire physical facility assuming it will give continuous happiness, but after getting it, the happiness may remain temporary. When desire, thought and expectation are guided by right understanding, the Self becomes clear about what it really wants: continuous happiness. In harmony, the Self verifies proposals on the basis of natural acceptance and acts according to right understanding. This leads to clarity, peace and satisfaction within.
lq.QUESTION_DESC: What is harmony in the Self? Explain with the activities of desire, thought and expectation.
